propositions: A corrective coaching move must be added to direct agents to re-derive source-code references using Serena's symbol tools when plan reviews find incomplete or manually enumerated code inventories.
The criterion must route to plan_review only and never code_review, because project.* criterion IDs cannot enter code_review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would create a dead move.

The criterion must be advisory (default_posture: advisory) with no blocking_enabled key, and must direct re-derivation including the string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr) that LSP-based symbol resolution cannot resolve.
Code-review moves already load project extensions from .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring changes are required.
The overlay configuration (criterion routing, prompt, move) must be validated as self-consistent and must not appear in src/rebar/ shipped defaults, ensuring other rebar clients remain unaffected.
